description: This Kotlin test source file contains unit tests for the DeviceNotificationListenerService class in an Android application. It verifies functionality related to sharing preferences, package list management, quiet hours, and rate limiting behavior.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationListenerServiceTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that contains multiple test methods to verify the behavior of DeviceNotificationListenerService, including preference migration, cleanup, package list deduplication, quiet hours enforcement, and rate limiting.

methods.name: recentPackages_migratesLegacyPreferenceKey
methods.description: Tests that legacy 'notifications.recentPackages' preferences are migrated correctly to the new key and the legacy key is removed.

methods.name: recentPackages_cleansUpLegacyKeyWhenNewKeyAlreadyExists
methods.description: Tests that if the new preferences key exists, the legacy key is cleared upon retrieval.

methods.name: recentPackages_trimsDedupesAndPreservesRecencyOrder
methods.description: Ensures that duplicate package entries are deduplicated and the recency order is preserved.

methods.name: quietHoursAndRateLimitingUseWallClockTimeNotNotificationPostTime
methods.description: Tests that quiet hours and rate limiting are based on wall clock time, not notification post time.

methods.name: burstLimiter_capsAnyForwardedNotificationEvent
methods.description: Verifies that the NotificationBurstLimiter caps the number of forwarded notifications per minute.
